How it works
Give every applicant a fairer first look. You decide who moves forward
Script built from Job Description
AI suggests questions and answer rubrics based on your job description.
Customise questions and rubric
You customise and approve the content, voice, and permissions.
AI asks questions, probes and records
AI agents ask and record candidate responses, including probing follow-up questions, in a natural two-way conversation.
Evaluates evidence of rubric in response
AI evaluates each response against your role-specific criteria, highlights whether it meets them, and explains why.
Recruiters see scores in ATS
Recruiters view scores in the ATS and quickly decide the next steps.

AI Interviewer in practice

A pod of recruiters were buried under 10,000+ screening interviews for registered nursing roles. The volume wasn’t just overwhelming, it meant great candidates were getting lost. Healthcare is highly regulated, so teams needed a trusted enterprise grade solution.
“We can’t believe how much time this has already saved us. Our team can now focus on what matters most: the candidate experience. AI Interviewer didn’t just help us catch up on our backlog, it keeps us ahead of it.”

Yes. All the basics you’d expect. What’s different is how enterprise-ready it is: advanced controls, oversight, and guardrails built in from day one.
We have layered checks review outputs, flag anomalies, and make it easy to audit and escalate edge cases.
Not when it’s used in the right place. Screening becomes more consistent and flexible, and humans stay front-and-centre later in the process. In our candidate feedback, 78% said they prefer AI screening over a human screen.
A rubric-driven interview can be fairer than an unstructured human screen because it focuses on job-relevant criteria, asks comparable questions, and documents the “why.” You can also monitor outcomes over time and tune the rubric.
Every score ties back to evidence from the interview and your competency rubric. If you want “receipts,” you’ll have them.
Absolutely. Configure by role, level, location, and team, then calibrate with hiring managers so the signal matches what you actually hire for.
Yes. It’s designed to slot into your process, with results flowing back to the candidate record so recruiters and managers stay in their normal tools.
Yes, you can add your logo, brand colors, and customise the copy and tone for all communications. You can also describe your culture to answer candidate questions.
Your data stays yours. Any data usage beyond running your interviews is explicit and controlled, not a hidden default.
Structured interviews help, and reviewable transcripts make patterns easier to spot. Suspicious cases can be flagged for human review instead of blindly passing through.
